texts: Coffee and cacao beans both undergo fermentation after harvesting — the same microorganisms break down sugars in both, and experts believe this step accounts for up to 60% of each bean's final flavor profile, making chocolate and coffee more alike than most people realize.

The 2020 pandemic caused home coffee consumption to spike 30% while café sales plummeted over 40% — this sudden shift reversed a decades-long trend of increasing away-from-home coffee drinking and forced millions to become home baristas practically overnight.

A single coffee plant can simultaneously have flowers, green cherries, and ripe red cherries on the same branch — unlike most fruit trees that produce in one harvest season, coffee plants mature cherries year-round, meaning farms pick continuously rather than seasonally.
